description: Defines a custom unchecked exception class 'JsonRuntimeException' used within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package to represent JSON-related runtime errors, including methods for constructing and retrieving error details.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException
classes.description: A runtime exception class for errors related to JSON processing, providing constructors, error code management, and optional metadata like description and links.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for fluently creating instances of JsonRuntimeException with customizable properties.

methods.name: JsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with error code, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the specific error code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the description of the exception, if present.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the URI linking to additional info, if present.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new JsonExceptionBuilder to build exception instances fluently.
